editorial.blurb: Burrito Beach is a casual campus favorite known for fast service, generous portions, and a welcoming vibe—just order in person for the best experience.
editorial.insiderTip: Order in person rather than for pickup to ensure proper portions of meat; pickup orders tend to be rice-heavy. Arrive well before closing time for the most generous servings.

topDishes.note: large portions and fresh when ordered in person
